# mtncloud_catalog_orders (Data Source)

Lists your catalog orders, including those made in the console. What you have ordered from the catalog (the console's Inventory), with each order's status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_catalog_orders" "all" {}

output "catalog_orders" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_catalog_orders.all.catalog_orders : x.id => { name = x.name, status = x.status } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `catalog_item` (String) Only list catalog orders whose `catalog_item` is this (case ignored).
- `execution_status` (String) Only list catalog orders whose `execution_status` is this (case ignored).
- `name_regex` (String) Only return catalog orders whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.
- `status` (String) Only list catalog orders whose `status` is this (case ignored).

### Read-Only

- `catalog_orders` (Attributes List) The catalog orders, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--catalog_orders))

<a id="nestedatt--catalog_orders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `catalog_orders`

Read-Only:

- `catalog_item` (String) Catalog item that was ordered, for example `Create Project`.
- `execution_status` (String) Status of the order's workflow run, or empty.
- `id` (Number) ID of the catalog order.
- `name` (String) Name of the catalog order.
- `order_date` (String) When it was ordered (RFC 3339).
- `quantity` (Number) Quantity ordered.
- `status` (String) Order status, for example `ORDERED` or `FAILED`.
- `status_message` (String) Status message, or empty.
